test_cases.name: Valid login returns JWT and refresh token
Invalid credentials reject with 401 Unauthorized
Token expiration triggers re-auth or logout
Logout revokes local session tokens
Protected routes redirect unauthenticated users to /login
STUDENT role can access published lessons, forbidden from /admin
CONTENT_MANAGER can preview DRAFT and PENDING_REVIEW lessons
ADMIN has full management and user administration rights
TEACHER role can view student assignments and classrooms
Privilege escalation attempts on API endpoints return 403 Forbidden
HSK 1 to 6 listing loads correct unit counts and lesson hierarchies
DRAFT lessons are protected from student direct URL access (returns 404)
PUBLISHED lessons render correctly in syllabus tree and lesson player
Lesson navigation links maintain valid sequential order
Renders Hanzi, Pinyin, Vietnamese meaning, and contextual sentence
Pinyin tone marks conform to official orthography (tone sandhi handled)
Empty states handle missing audio gracefully with Web Speech TTS fallback
Word count matches syllabus canonical baseline (HSK1: 300, HSK2: 200, HSK3: 500, HSK4: 1000)
Grammar pattern structure, Vietnamese explanation and example sentences render
Grammar point mapping to lessons maintains relational integrity
Unit reading passages display formatted Chinese text and Vietnamese translation
Reading comprehension questions grade answers and provide feedback
Audio asset URL resolves with 200 OK and audio/mpeg MIME type
Missing audio files fallback seamlessly to Web Speech API synthesizer
Multiple choice questions grade selection correctly against Answer key
Incorrect answer displays pedagogical explanation in Vietnamese
Duplicate submission prevention prevents double scoring
Completing lesson awards designated XP to Student account
Idempotent XP awarding: re-completing same lesson does not duplicate XP
Lesson progress status transitions to COMPLETED in database
Status transitions follow DRAFT -> PENDING_REVIEW -> PUBLISHED strictly
Unauthorized publish attempt without CONTENT_MANAGER or ADMIN role fails with 403
Audit log captures content changes with timestamp and user id
User management lists accounts without exposing password hashes
System health check endpoint returns 200 OK and DB connectivity status
